title: Sign-in & sessions
summary: Sign in, stay signed in safely, and only do what your role allows.

title: People directory
summary: Find anyone in the company: search, filter by role and page through hundreds of people.

title: Teams & members
summary: Create teams and manage who is in them, with clear messages when something isn't allowed.

title: Projects
summary: Create projects, choose who is on them and open each project's own pages.

title: Tasks
summary: Plan the work as tasks: assign, filter, sort and edit them together, with rich descriptions.

title: Activity log
summary: See who changed what, newest first, all the way back.

title: Dashboard
summary: Charts and numbers on how the work is going, always current.

title: CSV export
summary: Download a project's tasks as a spreadsheet, however many there are.

title: Integrations
summary: Other tools are told when a task's status changes.

title: Team chat
summary: Every team has a live chat room.

title: Video calls
summary: Start a video call from the team's chat room.

title: Language & formats
summary: Use the app in English or Bulgarian, with local dates and numbers.

title: Running in production
summary: Nothing users see directly: the app starts safely, and problems can be traced and measured.
